title: GLM repeats more than20 malformed JSON strings inside source-observation tool arguments
review_basis: Full fresh158 native review4 history audited. More than20 escaped JSON strings are incomplete, even after progressively shorter test payloads; source observation never freshly saved. Original page visually inspected. This is tool-delivery failure, not an adjudicated fact score.
failure_oracle: Native file tools should accept data objects without requiring the model to serialize another JSON document inside a string. Preserve legacy compatibility, complete schema/source/blind/PASS guards, and refuse both payloads or malformed strings rather than auto-repairing them.
